text: Built a ticket router with Jev over the weekend. 500 support tickets, 4 questions each, finished in 71 seconds for about one cent. Routing accuracy on my 100 hand-labeled tickets was 91%. Repo in the replies.
jev is insane. that's it. that's the post.

Getting started with Jev in three steps: 1. sign up on the official console and create an API key; 2. pip install typesafe-sdk; 3. put the key into the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable and send your first request following the quickstart in the docs.
Jev is now available on our gateway in beta. Send state plus typed questions, get typed answers with probabilities.
Tried Jev on a Tetris bot. It is fast and cheap, but there is no reasoning at all, and a lot of the moves were plainly bad. Do not expect it to plan.

Same batch of 300 support tickets: Jev took 52 seconds and cost less than 1 cent; the small LLM we compared against handled only 110 in the same time, at about 5x the cost. I spot-checked 50 classifications and Jev got 44 right.
Selling Jev API access, no waitlist, instant delivery. DM me for pricing. Bulk discounts available.

What is Jev? A model that generates no text: it takes a state and typed questions and returns only judgements with probabilities. It is not a replacement for an LLM; the right way to use it is to hand it just the judgement part.
"Never hallucinates" is misleading. What it means is the output cannot fall outside your schema. The answer inside the schema can still be wrong.
